cases.mechanism_detail: A 353-bp Alu insertion in MAK coding sequence (p.K433Rins31*) introduces 31 aberrant residues and a stop codon; it is the most prevalent RP mutation in Ashkenazi Jewish families (39% of solved families).
cases.quote: The most prevalent RP-causing mutations are the Alu insertion (c.1297_8ins353, p.K433Rins31*) in the male germ cell-associated kinase (MAK) gene (39% of families with a known genetic cause for RP)
